channel.title: Groviadigi: blog and AI automation news
channel.description: Business automation, custom CRMs and AI news from Groviadigi.

item.title: AT&T runs nearly 500 AI agent workflows, and every one starts with a human checking it
item.description: AT&T says it now has close to 500 agentic AI workflows in production and plans to triple that next year. The more useful lesson for smaller firms is how it keeps people in charge until the agents prove accurate.

item.title: How we automated SEO for a finance firm without losing the human review
item.description: Growth Center plans a monthly SEO, AEO and GEO strategy, writes and fact-checks every blog, and still waits for a person before anything goes live. Here is how we built it.

item.title: IBM and Microsoft launch Imagine Enterprise, an AI agent platform with 6,000+ prebuilt agents
item.description: IBM and Microsoft have announced Imagine Enterprise, a platform for building, running and governing AI agents across business processes. Here is what it includes and what it means for smaller companies.

item.title: A social media dashboard that designs, learns and keeps the brand consistent
item.description: How we built a social media dashboard that makes on-brand banners for every blog, learns design from videos the team picks, remembers its mistakes and works with an SEO dashboard.

item.title: Gartner: only 21% of service leaders have cut agent headcount because of AI
item.description: A Gartner survey of 275 service and support leaders finds AI is mostly supporting customer service teams, not replacing them. Here are the numbers and what they mean for your business.

item.title: GitHub Agentic Workflows is now generally available: AI agents inside GitHub Actions
item.description: GitHub’s Agentic Workflows, which run AI coding agents inside GitHub Actions for tasks like issue triage and documentation, are now generally available on all plans. Here is what changed.
